Guest Journey 
Deliver seamless stays from booking to checkout.

Business Intelligence

properties.description:
At SAAM, we believe hotel management should be simple, efficient, and guest-focused. That’s why we built a cloud-based hotel management system (HMS) designed to transform the way hotels operate — from boutique properties to multi-property groups.

Traditional property management systems (PMS) are costly, complex, and outdated. They require servers, heavy maintenance, and often slow down operations. Our cloud-first solution solves these challenges by delivering a secure, scalable platform that empowers hoteliers to reduce costs, improve efficiency, and focus on what truly matters: delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Core Features of Our Cloud HMS:

🌐 Online Booking Engine: Guests can book directly on your website with real-time availability and rates.

🔗 Channel Management: Connect to OTAs and distribution channels to manage inventory across platforms.

🏨 Reservation Management: Simplify bookings, modifications, and cancellations.

👤 Guest Profiles: Store preferences for personalized service and repeat business.

🛎️ Check-in/Check-out: Streamline arrivals and departures.

💬 Guest Communication: Engage across multiple channels.

🖥️ Front Desk Operations: Manage room assignments, guest requests, and tasks.

🧹 Housekeeping Management: Track room cleaning status and schedules.

entity.name: Guestway
entity.description:
Guestway is an all-in-one platform that seamlessly integrates with your PMS to enhance guest communication, streamline operations, and accelerate growth. With smart tools like a unified inbox, guest app, and automated cleaning management, it’s purpose-built by property managers to help you scale easier. 

Our platform spans three core solution areas: 

Guest Journey 
Deliver seamless stays from booking to checkout. 

1. Unified AI inbox: consolidates all messages from OTAs, WhatsApp, E-mail and direct booking website in one place. 
 
2. Automated Messaging: configure personalized messages triggered by conditions such as length of stay, booking lead time, or channel. Send the right communication at the right moment, from booking confirmations to check-in instructions and beyond. 
 
3. Guest App: a personalized web app created for each reservation. That gives your guests all the information they need in one place, reducing questions and enhancing the overall stay experience by controlling the IoT devices in the room (smart lights, locks, A/C, ..). 
 
4. Review Center: a centralized dashboard designed that allows you to track the performance of your properties and answer guest reviews efficiently. 
 

Smart Operations 
Put your operations on autopilot. 

1. Multi-Calendar View: manage all listings, reservations, and cleaning schedules in one clear, consolidated calendar. 
 
2. IoT Integrations: control smart locks, climate, and energy systems, all from one place. 
 
3. Cleaning Management: automate scheduling, reduce errors, and keep teams in sync in real time. 
 
4. AI Operations Center (coming soon): proactively detect, prevent & resolve issues . 
 

Business Intelligence 
Our built-in analytics provide real-time insights into performance, pricing strategies, guest behavior, and operational trends.

📊 Reporting & Analytics: Gain insights into bookings, revenue, and occupancy.

🔌 Integrations: Connect with Hubspot,Stripe, Zapier, and other tools.

Our mission is simple: to future-proof hospitality by making hotel management effortless, efficient, and cloud-powered.

-Competitor rate tracking and price-position benchmarking

-Intuitive extranet for hotels of all sizes with quick setup

Unlike traditional RMS platforms, Ramsi requires no complex setup, integrations, or lengthy training. Hotels can go live in days and start optimizing immediately.

Because more standards, more audits, and more training don’t solve inconsistency.
They often make it worse.

The problem isn’t effort. It’s where standards live.

Standards that live outside the workflow don’t survive the workflow.

That leads to:

Fragmented systems and manual work
Low confidence in operational data
Delayed feedback that misses the moment
Inconsistent guest experiences

At the same time, guest expectations are rising.
Review scores now function like a conversion rate—small changes drive measurable revenue impact.

The solution: make standards executable.

Yipy installs a living execution system that turns standards into daily performance.

We call this The Consistency Dividend:

Define → Distribute → Deliver → Diagnose → Develop

In practice, Yipy enables:

One living source of truth for standards
Standards delivered at the point of work
QA that becomes daily coaching—not inspection
Real-time visibility across teams and properties

What leaders manage changes:

Minutes-to-feedback
Coaching frequency
Rework rate
Execution variance

Trusted by high-expectation operators

Used by teams at Leading Hotels of the World, The Ritz-Carlton, JW Marriott, Radisson, and independent luxury hotels.

Operators use Yipy to stabilize execution, improve manager effectiveness, and deliver more consistent guest experiences—reflected in reviews, loyalty, and revenue.

Follow Yipy for insights on closing the Execution Gap

entity.name: Graham Healthcare Capital

Headquartered in Nashville, TN, Graham Healthcare Capital (GHCC) provides permanent capital solutions to healthcare service and technology companies that have between $5-$75M in annual revenue and up to $10M in profit. GHCC has a differentiated approach that lies between a private equity buyout firm and a corporate strategic buyer. GHCC retains, backs, and aligns existing leadership and core principles, providing a supportive platform focused on long-term, sustainable growth.

GHCC leaders offer backgrounds and expertise in operations, value creation, and finance. They’ve built companies from the ground up and understand the importance of emphasizing culture, integrity, employee retention, and strategic investment overbuilding companies solely to maximize profitability in the short term.

Since GHCC holds companies indefinitely, our investment strategies are long-term in nature and focus on preserving the company's legacy. Founders continue to participate in the profitability of the company via distributions and typically retain a significant equity position in the company.

GHCC’s alignment strategy includes:
• low-leverage utilization
• no management fees
• no hurdle rates of returns or preferred capital that favors investors

Graham Healthcare Capital is part of the companies we invest in – not a misaligned equity investor or beholden to the competing priorities of a strategic buyer.
Unlike traditional private equity, we employ a low-leverage, buy-and-hold strategy, partnering with ownership teams over a longer-term investment horizon. This strategy allows for decision-making that is best for the company and its management.

CI (POP) DIP & PAY (MT-103) / SPOT+CONTRACT.

For the first trial shipment: [ATB]

 1. Buyer CP then Seller issue Сommercial Invoice and Proof of Product to buyer.

 3. Seller issue Dip Test Authorization and Tank Receipt to buyer.
 4. Buyer dips, confirms and verifies the product Q&Q.
 5. Buyer Pays with MT-103 with condition against successful loading and Title Transfer to buyer's name.
 6. Seller pays all fees, taxes, and commissions according to NCND/IMFPA.
This item is reviewed and agreed upon by both parties.

For the contract:

 After the successful trial shipment, the buyer signs the SPA and sends to seller a letter of credit like RDLC/DLC, irrevocable and confirmed. For a month delivery face value.
 Deliveries start as agreed to the contract.
 The buyer pay all delivery by MT-103 or similar and keep the letter of credit active for the all life of the contract.

If you accept our procedure and you have available real goods send your SCO

entity.name: Guestway
entity.description:
Guestway is an all-in-one platform that seamlessly integrates with your PMS to enhance guest communication, streamline operations, and accelerate growth. With smart tools like a unified inbox, guest app, and automated cleaning management, it’s purpose-built by property managers to help you scale easier. 

Our platform spans three core solution areas: 

Guest Journey 
Deliver seamless stays from booking to checkout. 

1. Unified AI inbox: consolidates all messages from OTAs, WhatsApp, E-mail and direct booking website in one place. 
 
2. Automated Messaging: configure personalized messages triggered by conditions such as length of stay, booking lead time, or channel. Send the right communication at the right moment, from booking confirmations to check-in instructions and beyond. 
 
3. Guest App: a personalized web app created for each reservation. That gives your guests all the information they need in one place, reducing questions and enhancing the overall stay experience by controlling the IoT devices in the room (smart lights, locks, A/C, ..). 
 
4. Review Center: a centralized dashboard designed that allows you to track the performance of your properties and answer guest reviews efficiently. 
 

Smart Operations 
Put your operations on autopilot. 

1. Multi-Calendar View: manage all listings, reservations, and cleaning schedules in one clear, consolidated calendar. 
 
2. IoT Integrations: control smart locks, climate, and energy systems, all from one place. 
 
3. Cleaning Management: automate scheduling, reduce errors, and keep teams in sync in real time. 
 
4. AI Operations Center (coming soon): proactively detect, prevent & resolve issues . 
 

Business Intelligence 
Our built-in analytics provide real-time insights into performance, pricing strategies, guest behavior, and operational trends.

Nexrova Technologies Private Limited is an AI- and IoT-powered hospitality technology startup building India’s first fully autonomous operating system for independent hotels.

Our platform integrates real-time IoT infrastructure with an AI-driven operational control layer to eliminate revenue leakage, reduce fraud, and automate hotel management with minimal manual intervention.

At the core of Nexrova is:

Smart Front Desk – Occupancy monitoring, booking validation, and room-status tracking integrated with a centralized cloud system.

AI Autopilot Engine – An end-to-end autonomous operations manager that handles guest enquiries (including WhatsApp automation), check-ins and check-outs synced with IoT validation, room service coordination, staff task assignment, and real-time audit monitoring.

Fraud & Revenue Protection Layer – Server-authorized check-ins, automated stay verification, digital audit trails for staff actions and payments, and real-time operational visibility for owners.

Our technology reduces operational fraud by 70–90%, improves transparency, and lowers operating costs for small and mid-sized hotels by ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, while operating on an affordable SaaS model pricing per month.

Nexrova aims to become the default AI-powered operating and control layer for India’s independent hospitality sector, digitizing and formalizing an otherwise fragmented and leakage-prone industry.

One living source of truth for standards

entity.name: Graham Healthcare Capital
entity.description:
Headquartered in Nashville, TN, Graham Healthcare Capital (GHCC) provides permanent capital solutions to healthcare service and technology companies that have between $5-$75M in annual revenue and up to $10M in profit. GHCC has a differentiated approach that lies between a private equity buyout firm and a corporate strategic buyer. GHCC retains, backs, and aligns existing leadership and core principles, providing a supportive platform focused on long-term, sustainable growth.

GHCC leaders offer backgrounds and expertise in operations, value creation, and finance. They’ve built companies from the ground up and understand the importance of emphasizing culture, integrity, employee retention, and strategic investment overbuilding companies solely to maximize profitability in the short term.

Since GHCC holds companies indefinitely, our investment strategies are long-term in nature and focus on preserving the company's legacy. Founders continue to participate in the profitability of the company via distributions and typically retain a significant equity position in the company.

GHCC’s alignment strategy includes:
• low-leverage utilization
• no management fees
• no hurdle rates of returns or preferred capital that favors investors

Graham Healthcare Capital is part of the companies we invest in – not a misaligned equity investor or beholden to the competing priorities of a strategic buyer.
Unlike traditional private equity, we employ a low-leverage, buy-and-hold strategy, partnering with ownership teams over a longer-term investment horizon. This strategy allows for decision-making that is best for the company and its management.

entity.name: OLHET
entity.description:
Olhet is a hotel guest journey platform designed to simplify how hotels communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay — completely free of charge. Built specifically for the hospitality industry, Olhet removes the cost, complexity, and risk traditionally associated with guest-facing technology.

The platform provides hotels with a fully branded, mobile-first guest app that centralizes key touchpoints across the guest journey. From pre-arrival information and check-in guidance to in-stay communication and post-stay engagement, Olhet helps hotels deliver a smoother, more connected experience without disrupting existing operations.

Unlike traditional hotel technology solutions, Olhet has no setup fees, subscriptions, contracts, or paid upgrades. Everything is free for hotels, allowing properties to modernize their guest experience without financial commitment or long-term lock-in. This makes Olhet accessible for independent hotels and scalable across multi-property groups.

Olhet is built and maintained by an in-house development team, enabling rapid iteration, high reliability, and full control over product evolution. The platform is shaped through close collaboration with hotels, ensuring features are practical, intuitive, and aligned with real operational needs rather than theoretical use cases.

Designed for fast adoption, Olhet requires minimal staff training and can be deployed quickly, reducing pressure on front desk teams while improving clarity and convenience for guests. The result is a guest journey platform that enhances communication, reduces friction, and supports better guest experiences throughout the entire stay — without adding cost or complexity for hotels.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

entity.name: Guestway
entity.description:
Guestway is an all-in-one platform that seamlessly integrates with your PMS to enhance guest communication, streamline operations, and accelerate growth. With smart tools like a unified inbox, guest app, and automated cleaning management, it’s purpose-built by property managers to help you scale easier. 

Our platform spans three core solution areas: 

Guest Journey 
Deliver seamless stays from booking to checkout. 

1. Unified AI inbox: consolidates all messages from OTAs, WhatsApp, E-mail and direct booking website in one place. 
 
2. Automated Messaging: configure personalized messages triggered by conditions such as length of stay, booking lead time, or channel. Send the right communication at the right moment, from booking confirmations to check-in instructions and beyond. 
 
3. Guest App: a personalized web app created for each reservation. That gives your guests all the information they need in one place, reducing questions and enhancing the overall stay experience by controlling the IoT devices in the room (smart lights, locks, A/C, ..). 
 
4. Review Center: a centralized dashboard designed that allows you to track the performance of your properties and answer guest reviews efficiently. 
 

Smart Operations 
Put your operations on autopilot. 

1. Multi-Calendar View: manage all listings, reservations, and cleaning schedules in one clear, consolidated calendar. 
 
2. IoT Integrations: control smart locks, climate, and energy systems, all from one place. 
 
3. Cleaning Management: automate scheduling, reduce errors, and keep teams in sync in real time. 
 
4. AI Operations Center (coming soon): proactively detect, prevent & resolve issues . 
 

Business Intelligence 
Our built-in analytics provide real-time insights into performance, pricing strategies, guest behavior, and operational trends.

entity.name: SAAM Property Management System
entity.description:
At SAAM, we believe hotel management should be simple, efficient, and guest-focused. That’s why we built a cloud-based hotel management system (HMS) designed to transform the way hotels operate — from boutique properties to multi-property groups.

Traditional property management systems (PMS) are costly, complex, and outdated. They require servers, heavy maintenance, and often slow down operations. Our cloud-first solution solves these challenges by delivering a secure, scalable platform that empowers hoteliers to reduce costs, improve efficiency, and focus on what truly matters: delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Core Features of Our Cloud HMS:

🌐 Online Booking Engine: Guests can book directly on your website with real-time availability and rates.

🔗 Channel Management: Connect to OTAs and distribution channels to manage inventory across platforms.

🏨 Reservation Management: Simplify bookings, modifications, and cancellations.

👤 Guest Profiles: Store preferences for personalized service and repeat business.

🛎️ Check-in/Check-out: Streamline arrivals and departures.

💬 Guest Communication: Engage across multiple channels.

🖥️ Front Desk Operations: Manage room assignments, guest requests, and tasks.

🧹 Housekeeping Management: Track room cleaning status and schedules.

📦 Inventory Management: Oversee room availability, amenities, and resources.

📊 Reporting & Analytics: Gain insights into bookings, revenue, and occupancy.

🔌 Integrations: Connect with Hubspot,Stripe, Zapier, and other tools.

💰 Finance & HR Management: Control cash registers, payroll, and staff attendance.

Our mission is simple: to future-proof hospitality by making hotel management effortless, efficient, and cloud-powered.
If you’re a hotel owner, manager, or operator seeking to cut costs, streamline operations we would be happy to hear from you

When standards live in binders, PDFs, SharePoint, or tribal knowledge, execution varies—by shift, department, and tenure.

Yipy exists to fix that.

Yipy is the creator of the Hospitality Standards Management System (HSMS)—a new operational system designed to close the Execution Gap.

Because more standards, more audits, and more training don’t solve inconsistency.
They often make it worse.

The problem isn’t effort. It’s where standards live.

Standards that live outside the workflow don’t survive the workflow.

That leads to:

Fragmented systems and manual work
Low confidence in operational data
Delayed feedback that misses the moment
Inconsistent guest experiences

At the same time, guest expectations are rising.
Review scores now function like a conversion rate—small changes drive measurable revenue impact.

The solution: make standards executable.

Yipy installs a living execution system that turns standards into daily performance.

We call this The Consistency Dividend:

Define → Distribute → Deliver → Diagnose → Develop

In practice, Yipy enables:

One living source of truth for standards
Standards delivered at the point of work
QA that becomes daily coaching—not inspection
Real-time visibility across teams and properties

What leaders manage changes:

Minutes-to-feedback
Coaching frequency
Rework rate
Execution variance

Trusted by high-expectation operators

Used by teams at Leading Hotels of the World, The Ritz-Carlton, JW Marriott, Radisson, and independent luxury hotels.

Operators use Yipy to stabilize execution, improve manager effectiveness, and deliver more consistent guest experiences—reflected in reviews, loyalty, and revenue.

Follow Yipy for insights on closing the Execution Gap

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
